zh: 成交额集中在一天较晚时段的币，后面表现更好
en: Coins whose dollar volume falls later in the UTC day tend to do better.

zh: 一天最后六小时成交额占比高的币，后面表现更好
en: Coins that trade a larger share of their dollar volume in the last six hours of the UTC day tend to do better.

zh: 亚洲时段成交额占比高的币，后面表现更差
en: Coins that trade a larger share of their dollar volume in the early UTC hours, the Asian session, tend to do worse.

zh: 成交额集中在单独一分钟的币，后面表现更好
en: Coins whose dollar volume is concentrated in a single minute of the day tend to do better.

zh: 一天内成交一阵一阵、很不均匀的币，后面表现更好
en: Coins that trade in sudden bursts within the day, rather than evenly, tend to do better.

zh: 成交量更多落在上涨分钟的币，后面表现更好
en: Coins with more of their volume in the minutes when the price rises tend to do better.

zh: 成交量更多落在下跌分钟的币，后面表现更差
en: Coins with more of their volume in the minutes when the price falls tend to do worse.

zh: 跌幅主要发生在一天晚段的币，第二天更容易涨
en: Coins whose losses come later in the UTC day tend to do better the next day.

zh: 跌幅主要发生在一天早段的币，后面表现更差
en: Coins whose losses come early in the UTC day tend to do worse.

zh: 涨幅主要发生在一天晚段的币，第二天表现更好
en: Coins whose gains come later in the UTC day tend to do better the next day.

zh: 每分钟涨跌都跟着大盘走的币，后面表现更好
en: Coins whose minute-by-minute moves follow the market tend to do better.

zh: 一天内自己走、和大盘不同步的币，后面表现更差
en: Coins that move on their own within the day, out of step with the market, tend to do worse.
